name: Frame Stepper
description: Adds an in-game hold-to-step frame stepper overlay for Android.

enable-frame-stepper.name: Enable Frame Stepper
enable-frame-stepper.description: Shows the frame stepper overlay and freezes gameplay until you hold the button.

step-interval-ms.name: Step Interval (ms)
step-interval-ms.description: Milliseconds between each frame step while holding the overlay button.
